Process.heroLead: From the first conversation to long-term support, every project follows a clear path, so you always know where things stand.
Process.step1Desc: We listen to your business, your goals, and the real problem behind the idea. No assumptions.
Process.step2Desc: We study processes, users, and constraints to define the right scope, not the biggest one.
Process.step3Desc: We design the technical structure: data, integrations, and key decisions, explained clearly.
Process.step4Desc: Clear, functional interfaces designed for the people who will use them every day.
Process.step5Desc: We build in short cycles with frequent deliveries you can see and try.
Process.step6Desc: We validate everything works: technical and real-use testing before going to production.
Process.step7Desc: We launch carefully: monitoring, backups, and hands-on support at go-live.
Process.step8Desc: We stay with you: maintenance, improvements, and a long-term relationship.
Process.ctaTitle: Ready to start with step one?
Process.ctaBody: The first conversation is free and useful, whatever you decide next.

Contact.faq1Q: How much does a project cost?
Contact.faq1A: It depends on scope: a landing page and a custom platform are different investments. After a short conversation we send a clear proposal with a fixed price and timeline, no surprises later.
Contact.faq2Q: How long does a project take?
Contact.faq2A: A website or landing page usually takes 2-4 weeks. Restaurant or point-of-sale systems and custom platforms take longer depending on complexity. We agree on a realistic timeline before starting.
Contact.faq3Q: Who owns the code and the data once it's built?
Contact.faq3A: You do, always. Code, infrastructure, and data live in accounts under your name from day one. You are never locked in with us.
Contact.faq4A: We stay available for support, fixes, and future improvements. We can agree on an ongoing maintenance plan, or you can come back whenever you need something new.
Contact.faq5Q: Do you work with businesses outside Mexico?
Contact.faq5A: Yes. We work remotely and communicate in Spanish or English, whichever works best for your team.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.intro: These terms describe the basic conditions under which ZIVELO provides software development and consulting services.
Terms.scopeBody: Every project starts with a written proposal describing scope, timeline, and price. Work outside that scope is agreed on separately before it begins.
Terms.ownershipBody: Once a project is paid in full, the client owns the resulting code, design, and content, except for third-party licenses and any ZIVELO tools reused across projects.
Terms.supportBody: Post-launch support and maintenance are covered separately and are not included by default in the development price.
